title: Quercetin for Cardio-Skeletal Muscle Health and Estrogen Deficiency

sections.abstract: Double blind randomized controlled parallel pilot trial of Quercetin vs placebo oral administration in 24 postmenopausal women. The study team will conduct a feasibility pilot in preparation for a larger efficacy trial that will test the protective effects of quercetin against cardiac and skeletal muscle dysfunction and changes in structure induced by estrogen loss and potential mechanistic pathways in post-menopausal women at risk of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFPEF).
